messages:
Ravi: Quick heads-up — quarterly access review popped an odd cluster of admin bindings in project billing-prod, looks like a service account (payment-processor@redwood-prod.svc) still has roles/editor and roles/cloudkms.admin. Can volunteers triage?
Jordan: :eyes: can you paste the exact member lines? I'll run an audit query.
Ravi: here's the snippet I saw in the export:
```
bindings:
- role: roles/editor
  members:
  - serviceAccount:payment-processor@redwood-prod.svc
- role: roles/cloudkms.admin
  members:
  - serviceAccount:payment-processor@redwood-prod.svc
```
Adele: I'll take first pass on owner confirmation and reach out to Payments. ETA 2h.
Eli: heads-up — if we remove cloudkms.admin we need to ensure the svcacct can still access key versions for rotation. Check KeyRing policy first.
Ravi: noted. Action plan: 1) confirm owner, 2) create temporary least-priv binding for billing-runner role, 3) create Jira SEC-4123 for prune + rollback playbook, 4) run audit log query to surface any calls to CryptoKeyVersions during last 30d.
Jordan: running query now — using BigQuery export:
```
SELECT protopayload_auditlog.authenticationInfo.principalEmail, protoPayload.methodName
FROM `project.audit_logs.cloudaudit_googleapis_com_activity_*`
WHERE protopayload_auditlog.authenticationInfo.principalEmail = 'serviceAccount:payment-processor@redwood-prod.svc'
AND protoPayload.methodName LIKE '%CryptoKey%'
AND timestamp >= TIMESTAMP_SUB(CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), INTERVAL 30 DAY)
```
Security-bot: :white_check_mark: Created ticket SEC-4123 (surgical entitlement pass). Link: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/SEC-4123
Adele: Payments confirms it's used by a legacy batch job scheduled weekly. They're going to migrate creds to a dedicated worker and deprecate this svcacct. ETA 3 business days. :thumbsup:
Eli: when removing roles, let's prefer removing the two broad roles and adding explicit `roles/cloudkms.cryptoKeyEncrypterDecrypter` scoped to the key ring if needed. Also add an entry to Access Change Log: `chg-1765439998`.
Ravi: thanks — I'll wait for Payments migration then run the prune. Jordan plz upload the BQ results to SEC-4123 (attach CSV).
Jordan: done. Uploaded CSV and flagged two CryptoKey accesses on 2026-02-14. Also added a note about an elevated run around midnight 2026-02-15.
Adele: leaving a short remediation runbook in the ticket: steps to remove roles, add scoped KMS role, test in staging, rollback by restoring previous IAM policy from GCP backup.
Eli: reminder to rotate any keys the svcacct had access to after role change as part of the incident closure.
Ravi: plan set. I'll close the loop after Payments finishes migration. Thanks all. :pray:
